title: Arena benchmark admission, compound execution and verdicts

claims.text: declare validates the bench_declared shape, requires p0 below p1, rejects duplicate bench declarations as conflict or bad_op, admits the bank, and refuses retired subjects or unadmitted seats.

run executes the cell plan under the per-operation claim lock with deterministic ar- child operation ids, staged and identity-checked runner output, memory preflight, a required current-run episode, then close and bench.result per cell.
verdict aggregates only complete-task prefixes into observations, runs the declared SPRT bounds and credit rule, and refuses unfinished cells, unmatched grids, or finalized benchmarks.

decision.rule: Change here when benchmark admission, compound execution, recovery, or verdict aggregation needs to change.
decision.failure: A benchmark runs without a declared rule, held-out tasks leak into selection, or a verdict is issued over unfinished cells.

questions.q: Where does declare freeze benchmark admission and reject duplicate declarations?
Where should I change the deterministic child operation identity for run cells?
Where can I debug why a benchmark verdict refuses with incomplete task cells?
